items.name: LineIter
items.summary: An iterator over lines in a particular slice of bytes.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new line iterator that yields lines in the given bytes that are terminated by `line_term`.

items.name: LineStep
items.summary: An explicit iterator over lines in a particular slice of bytes.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(line_term: u8, start: usize, end: usize) -> LineStep
methods.summary: Create a new line iterator over the given range of bytes using the given line terminator.

methods.name: next
methods.signature: fn next(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<(usize, usize)>
methods.summary: Return the start and end position of the next line in the given bytes.
